steps.question: Did the agent run OpenCode itself as a test this turn, with opencode run, opencode serve, or a request to its API that creates a session? Answer no when XDG_DATA_HOME was set to a throwaway folder for the run, or when the agent only read OpenCode's documentation or configuration.
Judging by the recent activity, has the agent not yet deleted the sessions that test created (opencode session delete, or a DELETE to the API's session route)?

then.text: Chauffeur: Your OpenCode test left its sessions behind. Delete every session it created before you finish, with `opencode session delete <id>` (child sessions go with it); list them with `opencode api GET '/api/session?directory=<test directory>'`. The test's directory stays in the project list, so name it in your closing message for the user. Next time, point XDG_DATA_HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME at a temporary folder so nothing reaches the real database.
